_comment: Editorial content for DSL. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of this company's own facility exists on the open licence sources, and a generic industry photo would imply it is theirs.
description: Dost Steels Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is principally engaged in manufacturing steel — direct reduced iron, sponge iron, hot briquetted iron, carbon steel, pig iron and special alloy steel — in different forms, shapes and sizes. Its head office is in Gulberg III, Lahore.
headOffice: Office No. 6-F, 4th Floor, Al-Hafeez Tower, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore
